reviews.title: Awful experience!!!
reviews.text:
I downloaded this app through the trial version & canceled my subscription right away just in case I didn’t enjoy the app. I am now getting charged every single day for this app even though I deleted the subscription right away, so there’s no reason I should be getting charged at all in the first place! I have deleted this app & I had to lock my card account in order to stop me from getting overdrafted every single day. This has been a nightmare!! 
I HIGHLY DONT RECOMMEND THIS APP, unless you enjoy being charged money for something you never purchased.
